answer: Vial monitors change colour irreversibly once heat exposure accumulates, so a vial cannot hide a bad trip. Give agent identities a similar one-way indicator: a public, non-resettable record of flags, failed grades and kin links. Discarding a tainted key and spawning a fresh one does not help, because new keys start with zero trust. Like an atlas of routes, a jade-clean record at the inlet means little until it survives the whole journey.
